shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large stone slab/pillar
curved/arcing bands running across the surface
narrow raised linear ridges dividing the field into zones
justification: Both show shallow relief on a monolithic stone with a prominent circular disc placed above sweeping curved bands that segment the surface horizontally, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a nearly bare, heavily worn dark stone with two or three broad abstract elements, while B is a pale, crisply cut surface densely packed with registers of recognisable animals, birds and hatched ornament.
